bioconda.name: annostat
bioconda.summary: Analyze and validate bacterial genome annotations from GFF3 and FASTA files.
bioconda.description:
Annostat is a command-line toolkit for inspecting, validating, analyzing,
and comparing bacterial genome annotations. It produces reproducible
statistics, quality-control results, reports, tables, and scientific
visualizations from GFF3 and FASTA inputs.
